title: What Park Brought Home From CHI 2026
summary: Alongside an Honorable Mention, the Barcelona conference brought fresh questions about making robots accessible, enjoyable, and useful over time.

sources.label: Read Chorong Park's original LinkedIn post

paragraphs.text: Chorong Park returned to Houston from CHI 2026 with an Honorable Mention and new ideas for her research on aging and human-robot interaction. Her April 21 reflection put conversations with researchers from different backgrounds alongside the formal presentations as highlights of the week.

Held in Barcelona from April 13 to 17, the conference recognized her coauthored work on robots and older adults' changing privacy boundaries. Workshops, papers, and posters offered further opportunities to discuss how interactive systems fit into daily life.

For Park, exchanges across countries and disciplines sharpened a connected set of questions: how can technology be more accessible, more enjoyable, and worth continuing to use? Her reflection links the experience of an interaction with the longer-term challenge of robot adoption.

She welcomed future collaboration across universities and industry. The invitation carried the energy of the conference back into her work in Houston, with an emphasis on learning from people who approach similar problems differently.
